tools.name: plan_motorway_vignettes
tools.description: Plan a dated passenger-car trip through Czechia, Austria, Hungary, Slovakia, Slovenia, Romania, Bulgaria, Switzerland and Moldova. Compare verified vignette validity, official links, separately payable tolls and optional VignetteGO quotes.

tools.name: list_vignette_catalogue
tools.description: Read the live passenger-car registration catalogue and total service prices for the eight enabled countries. A catalogue price is not a dated travel recommendation. Use plan_motorway_vignettes for rules, vehicle class, travel dates and separate tolls.
